source: Wording from the user-supplied English translation of al-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-bayān (Dār Hajar edition)

verses.1: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verses.2: Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.
verses.4: Owner of the Day of Judgement.
verses.5: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
verses.6: Guide us to the straight path.
verses.7: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who incur wrath, nor of those who go astray.
